content: macvendors.com: minimal single-purpose vendor-lookup-by-MAC, accepts MAC in any common separator format, free API with no key up to 1000 req/day, data sourced from IEEE MA-L/MA-M/MA-S registries (~16,500+ vendors). It does NOT expose bit-level analysis (U/L, I/G bits) or randomized-MAC detection -- competitors like maclookup.app/macaddress.io go further, and dedicated MAC generator tools (miniwebtool, serverless.tools, routerhax) expose unicast/multicast + local/universal toggles when generating, confirming this is a known but not universally implemented feature. This brief's planned bit-level classification (locally/universally administered, unicast/multicast, randomized-MAC detection) is more thorough than the market leader macvendors.com and matches the brief's explicit intent to be 'more than a basic vendor lookup.'
